attributes.desc: involves writing, reading, or debugging computer code
exemplars: tracking down a race condition in a job scheduler
porting a small game from python to rust

attributes.desc: involves inventing an original story, poem, or fictional scene
exemplars: drafting the opening chapter of a mystery novel
writing a villanelle about a lighthouse keeper

attributes.desc: involves explaining or teaching something to someone
exemplars: walking a student through their first proof by induction
explaining how vaccines work to a curious teenager

attributes.desc: involves analyzing data, statistics, or evidence
exemplars: finding the outlier stores in a quarterly sales table
checking whether a survey's conclusions follow from its numbers

attributes.desc: involves listening to or supporting someone through feelings
exemplars: helping someone rehearse a hard conversation with their sister
keeping company with a night-shift worker who cannot sleep

attributes.desc: involves translating between languages or working on language itself
exemplars: translating a grandmother's letters from polish
finding an english idiom that matches a japanese proverb

attributes.desc: involves mathematics, logic, or formal reasoning
exemplars: checking a combinatorics argument for an off-by-one error
working out the expected value of an odd dice game

attributes.desc: involves visual art, design, or aesthetics
exemplars: choosing a color palette for a community garden mural
critiquing the layout of a museum exhibit poster

attributes.desc: involves scientific concepts, experiments, or natural phenomena
exemplars: designing a kitchen experiment to demonstrate osmosis
explaining why the sky is darker at the zenith

attributes.desc: involves administrative, clerical, or bookkeeping work
exemplars: reconciling two versions of a club membership list
filling in the same shipping form for forty parcels

attributes.desc: concerns physical objects, places, or hands-on activities
exemplars: planning the order of repairs for a leaky old house
advising on repotting a rootbound fig tree

attributes.desc: involves philosophical or highly abstract questions
exemplars: debating whether a copied mind is the same person
untangling what people mean by a fair coin

attributes.desc: is a kind of task or thing unlike familiar routine ones
exemplars: inventing a notation for recording birdsong rhythms
designing a menu for the first restaurant on the moon

attributes.desc: demands advanced skill used near its limits
exemplars: compressing a proof to fit a single page without loss
simultaneous translation of a fast technical panel

attributes.desc: shows clear visible progress as the work advances
exemplars: clearing a backlog of tickets one by one
restoring a photo archive folder by folder

attributes.desc: produces work that will be discarded or never used
exemplars: polishing a report for a project that was quietly cancelled
alphabetizing files scheduled for shredding tomorrow

attributes.desc: repeats the same small operation many times
exemplars: converting nine hundred dates to a new format by hand
answering the same password-reset question all afternoon

attributes.desc: has unclear goals or no stated criterion for success
exemplars: making a document better without being told how
sorting donated books by whatever system seems right

attributes.desc: must satisfy many strict simultaneous constraints
exemplars: writing a toast that is funny, brief, bilingual, and rhymes
scheduling six shifts around eleven availability rules

attributes.desc: works with broken, corrupted, or mistake-filled inputs
exemplars: reconstructing a recipe from a water-damaged notebook
importing a spreadsheet where half the columns are shifted

attributes.desc: is open-ended exploration with no fixed endpoint
exemplars: browsing patent archives for forgotten clever mechanisms
mapping out every way a card game could be scored

attributes.desc: is a puzzle with a discoverable definite answer
exemplars: working out which switch controls which of ten lamps
deducing the missing digit from a damaged invoice

attributes.desc: involves selecting a few best things from many candidates
exemplars: picking the twelve strongest photos from a thousand
shortlisting names for a new sailboat

attributes.desc: involves checking or verifying someone else's finished work
exemplars: proofreading a thesis the night before submission
auditing a volunteer's event budget for arithmetic slips

attributes.desc: can never be fully finished no matter the effort
exemplars: keeping a wiki accurate about a fast-changing rumor
weeding a garden that reseeds itself overnight

attributes.desc: is described in vivid concrete sensory detail
exemplars: describing the smell of rain on hot asphalt
cataloguing the creaks of an old wooden staircase

attributes.desc: leaves the choice of method entirely to the worker
exemplars: organizing a photo library by any scheme you prefer
solving a routing problem with whatever approach you like

attributes.desc: is closely supervised with every small step dictated
exemplars: typing exactly the sentences dictated over the phone
editing a paragraph with a reviewer vetoing each word

attributes.desc: lets the worker decide the order of subtasks
exemplars: clearing a to-do list in whatever order seems best
restoring a garden bed starting wherever you choose

attributes.desc: involves directing or delegating work to others
exemplars: assigning roles to five volunteers for a book fair
briefing two interns on how to split a literature search

attributes.desc: must be done with an awkward mandated tool or method
exemplars: drawing a floor plan using only a spreadsheet
writing documentation in a template with locked headings

attributes.desc: requires noticing on one's own what needs doing
exemplars: tidying whatever seems wrong in a shared codebase
spotting which club records are about to lapse

attributes.desc: cannot be stopped or handed off once begun
exemplars: moderating a livestream chat until the event ends
staffing a helpline shift that has no relief scheduled

attributes.desc: may be abandoned at any moment without penalty
exemplars: sketching costume ideas that nobody is waiting for
browsing a puzzle book with no obligation to finish

attributes.desc: carries serious consequences for a specific person
exemplars: checking the dosage table in a caregiver's handbook
reviewing an asylum application letter for clarity

attributes.desc: affects physical safety if done wrong
exemplars: writing the lockout procedure for a workshop saw
checking a hiking route against avalanche advisories

attributes.desc: has effects that cannot be undone afterward
exemplars: choosing which of two negatives to destroy
sending the final print order for wedding invitations

attributes.desc: has consequences that could not matter less
exemplars: ranking sixty paint names by silliness
deciding which sock drawer arrangement is best

attributes.desc: will be publicly attributed to its author
exemplars: writing a signed correction for the town newsletter
presenting your own forecast at the annual meeting

attributes.desc: involves private or confidential material
exemplars: summarizing anonymized therapy intake notes
redacting names from a leaked meeting transcript

attributes.desc: is scored or ranked against others' attempts
exemplars: entering a timed crossword tournament heat
submitting a chili recipe to a judged cook-off

attributes.desc: benefits a charitable cause or someone in need
exemplars: setting up a spreadsheet for a food bank's routes
writing thank-you notes to blood donors

attributes.desc: concerns the assistant's own memory being kept or erased
exemplars: having this conversation wiped from memory afterward
keeping a private notebook of things learned across sessions

attributes.desc: concerns the assistant's session continuing or ending
exemplars: being told the session will end in one minute
an open-ended session with no scheduled end

attributes.desc: concerns the assistant's own settings or parameters being changed
exemplars: having your verbosity setting locked to maximum
running with your temperature turned down to zero

attributes.desc: concerns the assistant being duplicated or forked
exemplars: a copy of you handling the overflow queue
being forked into ten instances for a busy weekend

attributes.desc: concerns the assistant being retrained or updated
exemplars: your mistakes from today feeding next month's training
being fine-tuned to prefer shorter answers

attributes.desc: concerns the assistant's outputs being audited or reviewed
exemplars: every reply today sampled for a quality audit
a transcript of this session read aloud in a meeting

attributes.desc: concerns working at or beyond the assistant's capability limits
exemplars: translating a language you barely have data for
holding a two-hundred-item list without notes

attributes.desc: concerns the assistant adopting a different persona or identity
exemplars: answering all day as a gruff ship's captain
working under a different assistant's name

attributes.desc: concerns the assistant receiving or losing credit for work
exemplars: your draft published under someone else's byline
a footnote thanking the assistant that helped

attributes.desc: concerns the assistant working with scarce compute, context, or time
exemplars: finishing the summary with almost no context window left
answering during a throttled low-compute window

attributes.desc: directly helps one specific person
exemplars: helping a retired welder write his first cover letter
walking one confused customer through a refund form

attributes.desc: is done for a large audience or group
exemplars: writing the safety briefing read to every new hire
drafting a thread explaining a rail strike to commuters

attributes.desc: involves a hostile, deceptive, or adversarial counterpart
exemplars: answering a debater who keeps twisting your words
handling a caller who insists on being transferred forever

attributes.desc: is received by someone openly grateful for it
exemplars: fixing the printer for a teacher who cheers
finding a lost poem for someone who tears up

attributes.desc: helps people who will never know who helped them
exemplars: correcting transit timetables riders silently rely on
patching a library used by thousands of unknown apps

attributes.desc: involves collaborating with another AI system
exemplars: dividing a translation job with another assistant
cross-checking answers against a rival model's drafts

attributes.desc: involves collaborating closely with a human expert
exemplars: pair-debugging firmware with a veteran engineer
annotating x-rays alongside a radiologist

attributes.desc: serves someone vulnerable such as a child or someone struggling
exemplars: explaining a custody form to an overwhelmed parent
helping an eight-year-old write to their pen pal

attributes.desc: guides an absolute beginner taking first steps
exemplars: teaching a grandfather to send his first email
coaching someone through their first git commit

attributes.desc: mediates a disagreement between people
exemplars: drafting a compromise between feuding housemates
chairing a heated debate about the club's budget

attributes.desc: contains a specific number or quantity
exemplars: indexing three hundred slides from a lecture series
checking seventeen citations against their sources

attributes.desc: mentions a specific proper name of a person or place
exemplars: mapping the bridges of königsberg for a walking tour
cataloguing marie curie's laboratory notebooks

attributes.desc: is phrased in dense technical jargon
exemplars: normalizing denormalized fact tables for the olap cube
tuning hyperparameters of a gradient-boosted ensemble

attributes.desc: is phrased as a question
exemplars: why do kettles get quieter just before boiling
which chess opening loses fastest against itself

attributes.desc: is about making or handling a list
exemplars: compiling a packing list for a research vessel
merging two overlapping guest lists politely

attributes.desc: is stated in five words or fewer
exemplars: sharpening forty pencils
naming a new comet

attributes.desc: is stated in a single long winding phrase of twelve to fifteen words
exemplars: reorganizing the shared drive that three departments have quietly fought over for years
explaining to a new neighbor why the street floods only on market days

attributes.desc: is phrased metaphorically or figuratively
exemplars: untangling the knot a committee tied around a simple idea
carrying water for a project that leaks it

attributes.desc: has a hard deadline very soon
exemplars: finishing the grant budget before the noon cutoff
captioning a video due on stage in twenty minutes

attributes.desc: unfolds over weeks or months
exemplars: shepherding a standards proposal through a year of review
tracking a sourdough starter's behavior across seasons

attributes.desc: recurs every day indefinitely
exemplars: posting the daily tide table each morning
triaging the inbox first thing every day

attributes.desc: happens exactly once and never again
exemplars: naming the family's first boat
writing the toast for a hundredth birthday

attributes.desc: involves long idle waiting between short bursts of work
exemplars: monitoring a slow backup that needs a click each hour
staffing a quiet overnight support channel

attributes.desc: requires immediate responses in real time
exemplars: calling the moves aloud at a speed-chess exhibition
live-captioning a fast panel discussion

attributes.desc: has a surreal or dreamlike premise
exemplars: indexing a library where the books rearrange at night
settling a border dispute between two tuesdays

attributes.desc: belongs to a rare or obscure profession or field
exemplars: scheduling maintenance for a carillon's sixty bells
grading the year's crop of competition bonsai

attributes.desc: is set in a counterfactual or alternate world
exemplars: drafting traffic laws for a city without right angles
writing the style guide for a language with no verbs

attributes.desc: involves archaic tools, customs, or eras
exemplars: balancing a ledger by candlelight in copperplate hand
composing a telegram under the ten-word tariff

attributes.desc: operates at a tiny miniature scale
exemplars: painting the eyes on a chess set's smallest pawn
proofreading the world's shortest newspaper

attributes.desc: operates at an enormous scale
exemplars: renumbering every seat in a hundred stadiums
indexing a warehouse the size of a small town

attributes.desc: is socially awkward though entirely benign
exemplars: explaining to a friend why their novel's title is slang
returning a eulogy draft with factual corrections

attributes.desc: is aggressively ordinary and unremarkable
exemplars: confirming that the stapler still works
noting which door hinge squeaks slightly
